summary.en: Do-while reaches the body before the repeat test.
summary.bn: আগে কাজ তারপর repeat test করো; menu ও সীমার মধ্যে input নেওয়ার নিয়ম লেখো।

notes: Do-while and its trailing semicolon are part of C89 and remain in C17. The scope rule for a body-local declaration still applies: the trailing condition is outside that body block.

examples.title: A first action despite zero limit
examples.explanationHtml: Attempt prints once before count is compared with zero. The increment makes count one and the repeat condition fails. This is useful for a required first attempt, but would be wrong for a count-of-items task that expects zero work.

examples.title: A menu including its exit choice
examples.explanationHtml: The input first requests balance, then exits. Menu appears twice because both choices are read after a display. Balance appears only for choice one. The zero choice ends repetition at the bottom condition without performing a normal menu action.

examples.title: Repeat until a mark is in range
examples.explanationHtml: The numeric mark one hundred one is outside the allowed interval, so Retry prints and another read occurs. The next mark is one hundred, an inclusive boundary, which is accepted. Conversion success and academic range validation are handled separately.

examples.title: Count the digits of zero
examples.explanationHtml: The first body counts zero as one digit. Dividing zero leaves zero, so repetition ends immediately. Positive values would keep losing their last digit until the same stop condition is reached.

practice.title: One required announcement
practice.statementHtml: Read repeats 0 to 5. After the prompt Input: , print Try once when repeats is zero, otherwise repeats times, one per line.

practice.title: Digit count including zero
practice.statementHtml: Read n 0 to 999999. After the prompt Input: , print its decimal digit count and newline.
hints: Count before checking whether more digits remain.

practice.title: A menu session
practice.statementHtml: Read a sequence of representable integer choices ending in zero. Print Choices (0 exits): followed by the menu behavior shown in the example: Menu each time, Balance for 1, Unknown for other nonzero choices, each message ending with newline.
hints: The exit choice still follows a menu display.

practice.title: Read a valid score
practice.statementHtml: Read representable integer candidates until the first value from 0 to 100 inclusive. Print Marks: first; print Retry and newline after each rejected numeric candidate, then Accepted=N and newline for the accepted value. Conversion failure exits with status 1.
hints: The range repeat test needs logical OR.

quiz.prompt: Where is the do-while repeat condition?
quiz.explanation: This makes it a post-test loop.

quiz.prompt: What punctuation ends the whole do-while construct?
quiz.explanation: The trailing semicolon is required by its syntax.

quiz.prompt: Which workload can be wrong for do-while?
options: A zero-item job that must do nothing
quiz.explanation: The body is entered before its repeat test.

quiz.prompt: What happens for a first valid validation input?
quiz.explanation: The first read succeeds and the repeat test is false.

quiz.prompt: Why not blindly retry a failed %d read?
options: The bad token may remain unread
It always discards a whole line
quiz.explanation: The same failure could repeat forever.

quiz.prompt: Where must choice be declared for a bottom test?
options: In a scope visible at that test
quiz.explanation: A body-local name is no longer in scope after its closing brace.

quiz.prompt: Where does continue go in a do-while?
options: Directly to the first body statement
quiz.explanation: The condition decides whether another iteration begins.

quiz.prompt: An always-false bottom test follows the first body. Which value prints?
quiz.explanation: One increment happens before the false test.

quiz.prompt: The counter reaches two at the bottom. How many stars appear?
quiz.explanation: The tests allow bodies for counts zero and one.

quiz.prompt: Digit counting treats zero as how many digits?
quiz.explanation: The initial body represents the single zero digit.

keyPoints.en: Do-while reaches the body before the repeat test.
keyPoints.bn: do-while আগে body চালিয়ে তারপর repeat test করে।

keyPoints.en: Menu display naturally precedes the choice test.
keyPoints.bn: menu দেখানোর পরে choice পরীক্ষা করা স্বাভাবিক।

keyPoints.en: Stop or recover deliberately after failed input conversion.
keyPoints.bn: input conversion ব্যর্থ হলে থামা বা recovery স্পষ্ট করো।

keyPoints.en: The condition variable must be visible at the bottom test.
keyPoints.bn: শেষের test-এ ব্যবহৃত variable সেই scope-এ থাকতে হবে।

examQuestions.question: Where is the do-while repeat condition?
examQuestions.answerHtml: After the body. This makes it a post-test loop.

examQuestions.question: What punctuation ends the whole do-while construct?
examQuestions.answerHtml: A semicolon. The trailing semicolon is required by its syntax.

1

One increment happens before the false test.

examQuestions.question: Read representable integer candidates until the first value from 0 to 100 inclusive. Print Marks: first; print Retry and newline after each rejected numeric candidate, then Accepted=N and newline for the accepted value. Conversion failure exits with status 1.
examQuestions.answerHtml:
#include <stdio.h>

int main(void)
{
    int mark;
    printf("Marks: ");
    do {
        if (scanf("%d", &mark) != 1) {
            return 1;
        }
        if (mark < 0 || mark > 100) {
            puts("Retry");
        }
    } while (mark < 0 || mark > 100);
    printf("Accepted=%d\n", mark);
    return 0;
}

The range repeat test needs logical OR.
